Advantages
Consistent with SEMPPC Land Use and and Transportation Plan, Milwaukee Area Transit Plan, Air Terminal Master Plan and Pedional Airport System Plan.

Provides bus-modified rapid transit entirely over a controlled access freeway system.

Serves projected traffic demands for air transportation service.
Would divert airport oriented traffic from the congested local arterial street system.
